The work:

As a Consumer Product Data Scientist, you will be using the Databricks platform to analyze complex datasets, identify trends, uncover patterns, and provide meaningful interpretations for a highly visible online product. The ideal candidate will possess a robust background in data analytics, hands-on experience with Databricks, and a proven track record in consumer research and retail analytics, with a strong preference for incorporating AI solutions. You will leverage skills in big data collection, cleaning, and exploratory analysis to discover patterns, anomalies, and relationships using statistical methods and visualization techniques. Requires strong experience applying statistical tests and models to validate hypotheses and identify significant trends in customer retention and churn.

Here's what you need:
• 10+ years of experience in data analytics to drive impactful insights and solutions.
• Must have hands-on experience within Databricks environment.
• Must have hands-on experience developing and maintaining analytics and dashboards to support client decision-making.
• Must have experience with consumer research and retail analytics.
• Demonstrates successful outcomes with quantifiable metrics.
• Incorporate success in integrating AI-driven solutions into analytics projects (strongly desired).
